5160101.text: This Hanamizaka bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all sorts of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

5160201.text: Former Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki has presently been relieved from his post. He faces charges of dereliction, corruption, endangering the nation and its people, among others, and is awaiting judgment.

5160202.text: Due to his age and in consideration of his accomplishments, he has been confined to his quarters indefinitely, and will not be released on bail.

5160203.text: If he commits any other offenses, he will be punished with extreme prejudice and without clemency.

5160204.text: While the Tenryou Commission discusses matters of reformation, its duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

5160205.text: There will be no adjustment in Doushin and Yoriki ranks. Overall command has been ceded to Madam Kujou Sara.

5160301.text: "Kujou Tengu! I think the entrance to Hanamizaka is a good spot for a sumo duel! Where are you!?"

5160302.text: "Put all that military and governance stuff aside for a day, and let's have a good match! Or did you leave your samurai honor on the battlefield where you dropped it?"

5160303.text: "Huh. Come to think of it, I haven't seen a single public sumo match held on any street ever since the Sakoku Decree took effect."

5160304.text: "Madam Kujou Sara, please assent to Mr. Arataki's challenge for once! This might be out of line, but we too would like to witness your might!"

5160305.text: Dear citizens, please do not join hands with those who harass public officials and vandalize public property!

5160306.text: Madam Kujou Sara has given us repeated assurances that she has nothing to do with this person!

5160401.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

5160402.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

5160501.text: We urge all citizens to remain calm. The Tenryou Commission's stability and its management of Tenshukaku's defense are now in Madam Kujou Sara's capable hands.

5160502.text: Rest assured that Kujou Takayuki's militant brutality, forced seizure of Visions, and suppression of the citizenry is now being reversed post-haste!

5160601.text: "Due to recent peace treaty between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya, the supply of Jade Steel has ceased."

5160602.text: "There will still be many days ahead, and government policy may yet be adjusted..."

5160603.text: "Please wait a while longer if you have any need for Jade Steel weapon restoration or forging."

5160604.text: "I, Amenoma Tougo, sincerely apologize, and wish for your understanding."

5160701.text: "Bantan Sango: We'll investigate anything on your behalf!"

5160702.text: "Missing persons, missing pets, marital investigations, criminal investigations, commercial commissions, delivery services, procurement services..."

5160703.text: "Just make us a suitable offer, and we'll even capture the likes of bandit chiefs Zenigata or Domeki for you!"

5160704.text: "Oh, and by the way, do not believe that Heizou person who calls himself a 'detective'! He's a liar and a charlatan!"

5160705.text: "Is this what they call intra-service rivalry?"

5160706.text: "We're not competitors — we're not even in the same line of work!"

5160801.text: "Konda Village has a large dye field that is presently in need of re-cultivation, and we are short of manpower to accomplish this task. As such, I'd like to ask for some help from some youngsters from the city."

5160802.text: "Our village is far from rich, but as long as you're willing to work, I, Konda Densuke, promise that you will be well compensated!"

5160803.text: "Those of you with families can bring them here to Konda Village. Food and board will be provided by us, all the better to make the village thrive more!"

5160804.text: "Chief, wouldn't it be better just to do some paid tourism or something rather than make advertisements like this one?"

5160805.text: "Oh, shut it with your crazy ideas! We're not taking anyone's Mora!"

5160901.text: Returning, demobilized samurai can report to the Yashiro Commission estates to receive subsidies and indicate their preferred avenues of future employment.

5160902.text: Additionally, the Grand Narukami Shrine will hold sharing sessions for samurai who took part in the war and their families to help heal the traumas caused by the war.

5161001.text: "Seirai Island is being plagued by pirates once more, and the Yashiro Commissioner's reconstruction proposals have been delayed time and time again by the war..."

5161002.text: "Thankfully, a ceasefire has been signed. Perhaps now the Asase Shrine there can finally be refurbished."

5161003.text: "It's just that it's been several hundred years now. Who knows how many of the descendants of Seirai Island's inhabitants still have some impression of their homeland..."

5161101.text: Their Excellencies, the Almighty Ogosho and Watatsumi's Divine Priestess, both express their deep grief at the many tragedies that occurred at Tatarasuna and on Yashiori Island.

5161102.text: From this day forth, the Shogunate and Sangonomiya will begin reconstruction and redevelopment work in these lands in partnership with one another.

5161103.text: Together, we will pacify this war-torn land, bring the guilty to justice, and restore Inazuma's prosperity.

5161104.text: All the more must we follow the divine wisdom of Her Excellency the Shogun, acting as one to accomplish the great cause of Eternity.

5161201.text: "The Kiminami Restaurant will only serve the freshest and most authentic Inazuma cuisine!"

5161202.text: "Anyone ordering take-out will be greeted with Miss. Anna's smile!"

5161203.text: "May a sweet smile bring you a beautiful day!"

5161204.text: "She's just forcing herself to smile to bring in more business, isn't she..."

5161301.text: "If any citizen discovers Ms. Yoimiya setting off restricted fireworks inside the city, please try to stop her!"

5161302.text: "...Or reprimand her, at least. Do not indulge her!"

5161303.text: "Alternatively, please refrain from accepting the fireworks she gives out. That will do as well!"

5161304.text: "The Fire Brigade hereby urges everyone to pay special attention. Thank you very much!"

5161401.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

5161402.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

5161403.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

5161404.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

5161405.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

5161501.text: The signed hardcopy edition of "A Legend of Sword" by Liyue's best-selling author, Zhenyu, is flying right off the shelves!

5161502.text: Purchase your copy now and receive special setting notes and exquisite character badges as part of the package!

5161503.text: "I'm sorry, but I just had to ask: where is the author's signature? I took my copy home and I wound up spending the whole day looking for it, but without success."

5161504.text: *Special Note: the author's signature is quite the tortured thing, and may be mistaken for the pattern on the box set's lid without careful observation.

5161505.text: "Popular authors who fail penmanship... Is that the way of the world nowadays?"

5161601.text: "My young samurai friends, the doors of Shimura's are always open to you!"

5161602.text: "Lost your job? Not lucky in love? Whatever your troubles, come over here for a drink or two!"

5161603.text: "I, Shimura Kanbei, will welcome you any time!"

5161701.text: "Children and parents of the city and beyond: if you should be bullied by a red oni with long horns such that you lose toys, cards, Onikabuto, snacks, picture books, and things of this kind..."

5161702.text: "Please come down to Hanamizaka and look for Kuki Shinobu. I will do my best to return the lost items to you. Regrettably, I will not be able to help you with toys that have been broken or food that has already been consumed."

5161703.speakerName: Arataki "To the Victor Go the Spoils" Itto
5161703.text: "Hey, hey, Shinobu, you aren't taking pity on the vanquished again, are you?"

5161704.speakerName: Arataki "To the Victor Go the Spoils" Itto
5161704.text: "Those are trophies, you know? Trophies! I won them fair and square — and it was a lot of effort, too! You can't just give them all back just like that!"

5161705.text: "Oh, is that so? In that case, I won't drag you back the next time that tengu woman beats the snot out of you."

5161706.text: "Oh, come on, don't be like that!"

5161707.text: "You know, it's your fault that I'm more acquainted with every Doushin in the Police Station than I ever needed to be..."

5161708.speakerName: Arataki "No Prison Food For Me" Itto
5161708.text: "I never asked for you to get me out of there! Also, what's with that psychiatric evaluation you used to bail me out last time? Were you making fun of me!?"

5161709.text: Due to citizen reports, the two people who vandalized this noticeboard have been detained.

5161710.text: We are familiar with one another, yes, but please control yourselves.
